description: Search the Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) dictionary for product identifiers used by CVEs. Returns CPE 2.3 URI (cpe:2.3:a:vendor:product:version:...), title, deprecation status. Use this to find the exact CPE string before searching CVEs by affected product.

keyword.description: Product keyword to search the CPE dictionary. Examples: 'openssl', 'apache tomcat', 'nginx 1.18'. Returns CPE 2.3 URIs used to identify affected products in CVE records.

results_per_page.description: Number of CPE records to return per page. Range: 1–1000. Default: 20.

start_index.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with results_per_page to page through large result sets. Default: 0.

name: nvd.cpes.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: NIST NVD CPE Product Lookup
